headlines.blurb: Tampa Bay Rays traded C Nick Fortes to Boston Red Sox for RHP Angel Roa.

headlines.blurb: Detroit Tigers traded 3B Jace Jung to Los Angeles Angels for cash.

headlines.blurb: Seattle Mariners traded RHP Bryce Miller, RHP Logan Evans and LHP José A. Ferrer to Kansas City Royals for 3B Maikel Garcia, RHP L.P. Langevin and RHP James McArthur.
